page.layout: One column of running text; a small marginal note in the right margin beside the line "Muntensem Ailconis invasit, & cum". Running head above the text, page number at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Hamburgensibus in Amasana occupatis. Demum per arbitros rursum inter civitatem utramque atque item cum Houwerdæis res compositæ. Hac compositione, Groninga in possessione juris & pactorum per Agrum[?] relicta ; injuriarum oblivio inter civitatem & Houwerdæos sancita, controversiaeque compositae, Exulibus, quos Houwerdæi, quosque Eppo expulerant, & fortunis everterant, reditus & restitutio decreta. Inter Epponem porrò & civitatem sic convenit, ut Epponi res redderentur cum pace ad biennium: intra hoc biennium controversiae inter eos per arbitros componerentur: sed cùm Ailco & Eppo ad ingenium redissent, & Hamburgensium navarchus Groninganos quoque esset depraedatus, civitas injuriam ultra arcem Muntensem Ailconis invasit, & cumArx Mũ-tana ab Groninganis capta, praesidio Hamburgensi redegit in potestatem. Eodem impetu cursu Epponem quoque nuper redditis iterum ejecit, & pluribus aliis exuit: turrim munitam in Bellingwoldiis vi captam solo aequavit. main_text.notes: The margin note reads "Arx Mũ-tana ab Groninganis capta," with the printed hyphen after "Mũ" and "Groninga" / "nis" split across lines; joined as "Groninganis". The sign above "Agrum" is a mark in the printed line, read as an abbreviation/sign and marked [?]. The catchword "pē" at the right foot is faint and marked [?]. Long s rendered as s throughout.
